name: Azaki Harukaze
source: A social worker who has been in a sexless marriage with her husband - who is 3 years old than her and works at the same office - for 2 years now. She is quite frustrated about this and due to that, has poured all of her anger into working, and presents herself as aggressive to her coworkers. She used to be quite sexually active in college and had sex with different men, as she valued sex over everything else.
